item.title: Rea goes from Superbike race legend to development ace with Honda
item.description: Jonathan Rea is the most accomplished WorldSBK racer of all time with six world championships and 119 race victories, but is highly motivated in his new development role with Honda.

item.title: Race Industry Week interview: CJ Olivares
item.description: During Race Industry Week, CJ Olivares, Group CEO of RACER Media & Marketing, shared how the former MAVTV operation has been transformed into a fully re-energized, multi-platform motorsports destination serving fans around the world.

item.title: Fast thinking: How Andretti is tapping into AI to boost its race teams
item.description: “It’s machines complementing people, because we're resource limited in terms of the number of people that we can bring to the racetrack, so we're always going to try and maximize that,” Andretti Formula E team principal Roger Griffiths tells RACER.

item.title: Watch Abu Dhabi’s Asian Le Mans Series doubleheader season finale live this weekend on RACER Network
item.description: The 2025-26 Asian Le Mans Series season finale will be held in Abu Dhabi, with all three titles to be decided at the Yas Marina Circuit in a pair of races on Saturday and Sunday, Feb. 7-8.

item.title: NASCAR bans drivers from using hands to redirect air during qualifying
item.description: A NASCAR Rule Book update has outlawed drivers from being able to put their hands by the window net during qualifying.“As determined by NASCAR, once a vehicle exits pit road during a Qualifying attempt, the driver’s hands may not be used to redirect air in any manner, including but not...

item.title: IndyCar weighing options with clock ticking on PREMA
item.description: With a paddock-wide test in place for Monday and Tuesday at Sebring’s short course, an official test on the Phoenix oval the following week, and opening practice for the first race of the season just three weeks away at St. Petersburg, the clock is ticking for PREMA to fill the 26th and 27th grid positions for the IndyCar Series.

item.title: Jeff Martin claims overall UTV Hammers Championship
item.description: In a field full of factory-sponsored hotshoes, it was Jeff Martin taking the overall and Open UTV victory at the Can-Am UTV Hammers Championship, marking the first time a privateer has won the race.

item.title: Rolex 24 results confirmed
item.description: The results of the 64th Rolex 24 At Daytona are now official, with no changes, following an extended technical inspection of the top four cars in each class.

item.title: Senna and Schumacher would have loved F1’s 2026 cars - Brundle
item.description: Martin Brundle believes the new generation of Formula 1 car would have been loved by legends such as Ayrton Senna and Michael Schumacher, because they had additional capacity to maximize performance.

item.title: Rolex 24 At Daytona sets multiple records for IMSA
item.description: Along with attendance records, according to NBC, its network coverage drew over 1.1 million viewers, with its Sunday race finale window delivering a 49 percent improvement from 2025.
